_about: Public-domain Arthur Cleveland Coxe (1818-1896), Episcopal Bishop of Western New York, poet and controversialist, for the Word Hoard: Advent, a Mystery (1837), Christian Ballads (1840), Athanasion (1842), Saul, a Mystery (1845), Halloween, a Romaunt (1845), Sermons on Doctrine and Duty (1855), Impressions of England (1856), An Apology for the Common English Bible (1857), The Church and the Press (1859), Thoughts on the Services (1861), The Criterion (1866), Moral Reforms (1869), Apollos, or the Way of God (1874), Institutes of Christian History (1887), The Paschal (1889) and Holy Writ and Modern Thought (1892). Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 61 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
